pages.text: Frequently asked questions about investment tax, published by the SYN Revenue Authority. Question: How are money market fund returns taxed? Answer: 12 percent final withholding tax. Question: What is the withholding tax rate on dividends for resident individuals? Answer: 8 percent. Question: Is there a capital gains tax on shares? Answer: Yes, 2 percent of the gain. These answers are updated whenever the rules change. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
